housing.summary: Numbeo's Brussels cost-of-living page (last updated 18 August 2026) reports EUR 1,226.47 for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Brussels). For residential leases concluded or renewed from 1 November 2024, the Brussels-Capital Region caps the rental guarantee at two months' rent under Article 248 of the Code bruxellois du Logement (https://be.brussels/fr/logement/location/bail-dhabitation/garantie-locative). Immoweb has a dedicated Brussels City (1000) apartment-rental search (https://www.immoweb.be/en/search/apartment/for-rent/brussels/1000).

banking.summary: Newcomers need valid passport/ID card and proof of belgian residence (utility bill or lease). Banks: ING Belgium (ing.be), BNP Paribas Fortis.
required_docs: Proof of Belgian residence (utility bill or rental contract)

schools.summary: Brussels offers IB, British, American, European Schools and more. 10+ IB World Schools available.

legal_admin.summary: Foreign nationals must register at their local municipality (commune) within 8 days of arrival. Registration leads to residence card and National Number.
legal_admin.registration_step: Visit local municipality (commune) within 8 days of arrival to declare residence and request residence card.

tax_finance.summary: Belgian Tax ID is the National Register Number (NN/RRN), assigned automatically upon commune registration. Non-residents may obtain a BIS number from FPS Finance.
